name: vsc-chat-trail
description: Records one AI collaboration session in VS Code Chat (git diff, file saves, terminal commands, custom-participant model calls) and exports an HTML/JSON audit report. Local-only, no API key, no build step, makes no model calls.

vscChatTrail.outputDir.description: Output directory for session records (relative to the workspace root; the extension's global storage is used when no folder is open). JSONL raw logs and HTML/JSON reports are written here.

commands.title: VSC Chat Trail: ■ Stop session and export HTML report
